verdict.rationale: Isolated sandboxes are Blaxel's core product. Agents can create them by prompt or MCP (blaxel-docs-1, blaxel-docs-38), fork or snapshot them for disposable test copies (blaxel-docs-21), and run them from reusable images (blaxel-docs-32). Domain allowlists and denylists to prevent exfiltration, scoped secrets and non-root execution all help keep test runs away from production systems (blaxel-docs-28, blaxel-docs-31, blaxel-docs-30). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of isolation guarantees or dev/prod environment separation for data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
